name: Jacobe Smith
summary: A former collegiate wrestler and elite athlete, 12-0, with ground-and-pound finishes and some dynamic striking; overconfident and with defensive holes, but still getting overmatched opponents.

how_they_fight.Striking: Dynamic, athletic; knocked out Josiah Harrell in round one in February.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Heavy wrestling (about 4.9 takedowns per 15 minutes) and ground-and-pound.
how_they_fight.Defense: Holes (Sherdog); doesn't know what he doesn't know.

news.text: Added to UFC 332 on about nine days' notice against newcomer Bruce Whitehead.
